svg.title: Push growth sped up
svg.desc: Each of the 149 economies is compared with itself. The annualized public-push growth rate in 2024 Q1–2026 Q1 was higher in 110 economies and lower in 39 than in 2020 Q1–2022 Q1. A lower growth rate does not necessarily mean pushes fell. The earlier window is an observed comparison, not a forecast without AI.
svg.metadata: Data: GitHub Innovation Graph (CC0), https://github.com/github/innovationgraph/tree/078fb62ee4395d321bec9f4f06694cca68f6b6cb/data. Maps: Natural Earth (public domain); DataMeet India, CC BY 4.0, adapted. Full linked attribution accompanies each map in the gallery and notes.
